text:
Palladium Price in 2009
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2009, the LBMA palladium price rose 100.5% between 2009-01-30 ($196) and 2009-12-30 ($393). The highest sampled price was $393 in December and the lowest was $195 in February. The mean of these observations was $269. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
